title: Introduce operator revocation webhook, KMS attestation handshake and audit timeline reconciler
author: Aisha Raman
release_notes: Adds operator revocation webhook and KMS attestation verification; introduces audit timeline reconciler service to dedupe and reorder cross-region audit events. Backwards-compatible, canary rollout behind feature flag.
description:
Context and motivation: On several recent incident postmortems we observed that operator credential revocations and cross-region audit merges were slow to converge: revoked operator tokens remained valid at edge proxies for several minutes and audit entries arriving out-of-order made forensic timelines difficult to trust. This PR implements three coordinated pieces to mitigate these risks: 1) an operator revocation webhook that immediately invalidates operator-issued tokens and notifies edge caches; 2) a KMS attestation handshake to require provable key provenance for operator-scoped CMK operations; 3) an audit timeline reconciler that ingests per-region audit event streams and produces a canonical, deduplicated ordered timeline for post-incident analysis and compliance audits.

Implementation summary:
- Operator revocation webhook: new HTTP endpoint (/internal/v1/operator-revoke) implemented in src/auth/operator_webhook.go. When a revocation event is recorded (SQL migration adds operator_revocations table), the webhook writes a revocation tombstone and publishes an event to the internal pubsub used by edge proxies. Edge caches subscribe to the existing token-introspect topic and apply tombstones immediately. Revocation semantics are idempotent and implement an after-image to avoid race windows during near-simultaneous issuance and revocation.
- KMS attestation handshake: pkg/kms/attestor/attestor.go implements an attestation verifier that accepts signed key-provenance envelopes from supported KMS providers (AWS/GCP/Azure). The attestor validates envelope signatures, checks the CMK region/alias against tenant residency claims, and annotates the authorization decision with a signed attestation token included in the downstream audit entry. This prevents silent CMK proxying across pinned regions.
- Audit timeline reconciler: tools/audit/reconciler/main.go implements a lightweight reconciler service that consumes Kafka topics produced by the audit-forwarder from each region. It uses sequence anchors and a hybrid logical clock to reorder events, dedupe retries using idempotency keys, and emits canonical timeline shards to the compliance ingest. The reconciler also produces reconciliation markers (watermarks) that are ingested by the Console to show timeline completeness.

Rollout and compatibility:
- Database migration migrations/20240514_add_operator_revocation_table.sql adds operator_revocations and a small index; migration is zero-downtime (backfill handled by a small job).
- Feature flag config/rollout/operator-revocation-ff.yaml gates publishing of pubsub tombstones; default rollout: shadow -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Edge proxies will ignore tombstones until they receive a compatible client update; rollout plan coordinates SDK bump.
- KMS attestation is additive: if the attestation envelope is missing, existing behavior is preserved until the enforcement guard (config) is enabled.

Tests and validation:
- Integration/e2e test tests/integration/operator_revocation_e2e.test covers issuance -> immediate revocation -> edge cache expiry across simulated regions.
- Unit tests for attestor include mocked signed envelopes for AWS/GCP.
- Audit reconciler has an integration test that replays out-of-order streams and asserts canonical ordering and dedupe.

Observability and SLOs:
- New metrics in observability/metrics/operator_revocation.promql: revocation_queue_latency_ms, attestation_verification_latency_ms, reconciler_reorder_lag_ms.
- Added tracing spans and tags for attestation.provider and reconciler.watermark to aid debugging.

Security and compliance notes:
- Attestation tokens stored in audit payloads are base64-signed proofs; no plaintext key material is logged.
- The reconcilers strip sensitive data per existing audit-scrub rules.
- This PR addressed Linear items ENG-5584 and SEC-219 for time-to-revoke and audit-timeline-trust.

Commits (high level):
- 1d9b2f5: add operator revocation webhook handler and basic pubsub publish
- afc4e10: add DB migration for revocations and backfill helper
- b2c7d44: implement KMS attestor and test fixtures for AWS/GCP envelopes
- 8f0e7a2: add audit reconciler service skeleton and integration tests
- c4a123b: observability metrics and rollout config
- 7b9f0d1: docs and e2e tests

Feedback and review conversation:
- Daniel Park (review): "Overall looks good; two production concerns: (A) revocation pubsub storm detection — we need a circuit breaker so a compromised CI key can't flood edge caches; (B) schema migration: please add an index and a short-lived TTL cleanup job."
- Author reply (Aisha): "Added a token-flood circuit-breaker on the publisher (max 500 revokes/min globally, with exponential backoff). Migration now creates an index on (operator_id, revoked_at) and we added a one-off cleanup job (backfill script included)."
- Sven Ortega (review): "Need to measure reconciler memory usage and worst-case reorder window; we shouldn't buffer more than X MB per shard."
- Author reply: "Reconciler now exposes reconciler.buffer_bytes gauge and enforces a soft cap; on overflow it emits a reconciliation_failure metric and spills older events to an archived bucket for offline forensics."
- Maya Lin (approve): "Tests and docs look solid. Please add a short blurb to the on-call runbook about reconciling missing audit shards."

CI summary: initial run: unit tests passed, integration suite failed on flaky network test; reran integration suite and passed. E2E run passed in canary. Merge outcome: Squash-merged into main on 2024-05-20 by Daniel Park after approvals from Maya Lin and Sven Ortega.

Post-merge actions:
- Coordinate SDK bump (edge proxy client) to respect revocation tombstones (scheduled with SDK team; tracking ENG-5612).
- Start 5% shadow rollout and monitor revocation_queue_latency_ms and reconciler_reorder_lag_ms for 48h.
- Compliance: added entry for audit timeline reconciler to internal compliance tracker (SEC-219).

Notes for auditors: reconciler emits watermarks per region so auditors can reason about gaps; attestation tokens are available in the audit archive but redacted for PII.
